scripts.verify_pass3.py:
"""Verify bounded game switch tables and NE-backed game virtual tables."""
import csv, json, struct, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
p=(root/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(p).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
ne=struct.unpack_from('<I',p,0x3c)[0];st=ne+struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x22)[0]
shift=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,ne+0x32)[0]
off,size,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<4H',p,st+2*8)
code=p[off<<shift:(off<<shift)+size]
assert code[0x1162:0x1168]==bytes.fromhex('2d 62 00 3d 15 00')
assert code[0x116d:0x1172]==bytes.fromhex('2e ff a7 72 11')
assert code[0xdbc0:0xdbc4]==bytes.fromhex('48 3d 0a 00')
assert code[0xdbcb:0xdbd0]==bytes.fromhex('2e ff a7 d0 db')
t1=list(struct.unpack_from('<22H',code,0x1172));t2=list(struct.unpack_from('<11H',code,0xdbd0))
rows=list(csv.DictReader((root/'pass3/switch_targets.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t'))
for t,table in [(t1,'1010:1172'),(t2,'1010:dbd0')]:
    exported=[int(x['target'][5:],16) for x in rows if x['table']==table]
    assert exported==t
accepted=[]
for char in range(256):
    signed=char if char<128 else char-256
    i=(signed-0x62)&0xffff
    if i<=0x15:
        assert char==0x62+i
        if t1[i]!=0x119e:accepted.append(chr(char))
assert ''.join(accepted)=='bcdefloprsw'
for state in range(65536):
    index=(state-1)&0xffff
    assert (index<=10)==(1<=state<=11)
sites=json.loads((root/'pass2/relocation_chain_sites.json').read_text())
old={x['entry'] for x in csv.DictReader((root/'pass2-results/functions.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t')}
ptrs=[]
for a,b in [(0x4d4,0x644),(0x792,0x832),(0x8dc,0x950),(0xba0,0xc54)]:
    selected=sorted([x for x in sites if x['source_segment']==3 and a<=x['source']<b],key=lambda x:x['source'])
    assert [x['source'] for x in selected]==list(range(a+2,b,4))
    for x in selected:
        assert x['type']==2 and x['flags']==0
        target=f"{0x1000+(x['target_segment']-1)*8:04x}:{x['preceding_word']:04x}"
        ptrs.append(dict(table_address=f"1010:{x['source']-2:04x}",target=target,
            source_ne_segment=3,relocation_record=x['record'],is_existing_function=target in old))
assert len(ptrs)==206
with (root/'pass3/game_far_pointer_tables.tsv').open('w') as f:
    w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(ptrs[0]),delimiter='\t');w.writeheader();w.writerows(ptrs)
new=sorted({x['target'] for x in ptrs if not x['is_existing_function']})
assert len(new)==15
(root/'scripts/candidates4.txt').write_text('\n'.join(new))
summary=dict(exe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(p).hexdigest(),switch_entries=[22,11],switch_distinct_targets=[len(set(t1)),len(set(t2))],
    tested_command_bytes=256,tested_state_words=65536,recognized_option_letters=accepted,
    proven_game_far_pointers=206,unique_game_pointer_targets=len({x['target'] for x in ptrs}),
    newly_seeded_table_targets=len(new),new_dispatcher_entry='1010:db94',runtime_tests=0,complete_semantic_recovery=False)
(root/'pass3/verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
